topic: The Geometric Relationship: Sphere Surface Area and Projected Shadow

sections.title: Prerequisite Review: The Circle and the Sphere
lecture_lines: A circle's area is πr². [Asset: circle_anim]
A sphere is points equidistant from center. [Asset: sphere_anim]
Cutting a sphere creates a circular cross-section. [Asset: cross_section_anim]
animations: Show a cross-section circle appearing in #00FFFF (cyan).

sections.title: The Geometry of the Projected Shadow
lecture_lines: Parallel rays create a cylindrical shadow. [Asset: parallel_rays_anim]
The sphere's shadow is a circle of radius r. [Asset: shadow_circle_anim]
The shadow's area is exactly πr². [Asset: shadow_area_anim]
animations: Show parallel light rays in #FFFFE0 (light yellow).
Label shadow area formula πr² in #FF4500 (orange-red).

sections.title: Deriving the Sphere Surface Area
lecture_lines: Archimedes discovered a remarkable geometric truth. [Asset: archimedes_intro_anim]
A sphere's surface is 4 times its shadow. [Asset: surface_shadow_comparison_anim]
Four circular shadows cover the sphere exactly. [Asset: four_shadows_tiling_anim]
The total surface area is 4πr². [Asset: formula_reveal_anim]
This elegant ratio defines spherical geometry. [Asset: summary_anim]
animations: Compare sphere surface to shadow area.
Animate 4 circular shadows tiling the sphere.

sections.title: Practical Application: Calculating Solar Heat Gain
lecture_lines: Satellites receive solar radiation in space. [Asset: satellite_sun_anim]
Only the shadow area intercepts solar heat. [Asset: heat_interception_anim]
Heat spreads over the entire surface area. [Asset: heat_distribution_anim]
animations: Highlight interception area πr² in #00CED1 (dark turquoise).
